description: Small documented multimodal corpus for the varied-ingestion experiment named as future work in Section 5.4. Replaces the single reused single-page PDF (Reviewers 1, 2, 3). Place the actual files in ./corpus/ using the filenames below, then run repeat_ingest.py with distinct documents instead of the cyclic reuse. Each entry states what dimension of ingestion load it exercises.

documents.notes: baseline, matches the original paper corpus
long document, indexing and chunking load
embedded figures, exercises the vision path
OCR path, no embedded text layer

protocol.conditions: per-document (isolate modality effect) and parallel batches of 1, 2, 10 (isolate concurrency effect)
protocol.report: mean, standard deviation, 95% confidence interval per condition; Mann-Whitney U between cloud and on-premises per condition; full per-run latencies in the CSV
protocol.note: Author to populate ./corpus/ with real documents that match these descriptions. The manifest is a specification, not the documents themselves.
